description: Request that a real person attempts a task on a website or app, records the screen and reports friction points. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 49 per walkthrough (EUR 129 for three testers). Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

persona.description: Optional: who the tester should be, e.g. non-technical person aged 60+.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

task.description: What the tester should try to achieve.

url.description: https URL of the site or app (or store link).

name: request_usability_test
title: Request a human usability walkthrough
